meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: Claude 会为你的群聊搭建一个持久 wiki 知识库,分 sources、wiki、schema 三层,支持录入、查询、检查三种操作;收到多个文件时它会一个一个处理而不是批量。
howto.when: 当你说出“add wiki”“wiki”“knowledge base”等关键词,或要求给群聊搭建知识库时触发。

say.text: 给主群加上 wiki,主题是项目管理
say.note: 会开始搭建 wiki 结构和容器技能

say.text: 每周一检查一下 wiki 的健康状况
say.note: 会安排定时 lint 任务

say.text: 把这份 PDF 加进 wiki 的 sources
say.note: 会按 ingest 流程录入并更新页面

howto.what_en: Claude will set up a persistent wiki knowledge base for your group chat, with three layers (sources, wiki, schema) and three operations (ingest, query, lint). When given multiple files, it processes them one at a time.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'add wiki', 'wiki', 'knowledge base', etc., or ask to set up a knowledge base for a group chat.

say_en.text: Add a wiki to the main group, topic is project management.
say_en.note: Starts building the wiki structure and container skill.

say_en.text: Check the wiki health every Monday.
Add this PDF to the wiki sources.
